data.title: 诗怀雅 · 包装纸的选择
data.description: 店员拿来两张包装纸，她比较一会儿，选了更适合收礼人的颜色。
data.camera: 中景，包装纸与柜台同框
data.promptProse: At an upscale gift boutique counter, Swire compares two swatches of heavy embossed metallic wrapping paper between her hands. Spools of burgundy velvet ribbon and ornate brass scissors rest on the polished marble surface under flattering overhead chandeliers.
data.animaCaption: Comparing the gold-foil textures between her fingers, she decisively selects the richer pattern for the presentation box.
